data.body: Investigated and implemented fix for cycle-2 dismissal-memory gap. Root cause: DSO_REVIEW_CYCLE env var was read in runner.py but ignored (marked noqa F841); dispatch_two_call_review existed in dispatch.py but was never called. Fix adds: (1) _fetch_pr_defenses() reads DEFENSE_RECORD: lines from GitHub PR comments via gh pr view --json comments; (2) _suppress_defended_findings() downgrades verbatim re-emitted defended findings to 'suggestion' severity (non-blocking); (3) main() on cycle>=2 uses dispatch_two_call_review for light/standard tiers, injects defense context into arch synthesis for deep tier, and applies the suppression filter as a last-resort catch. Files changed: plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/runner.py, tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_runner_smoke.py (6 new tests, all passing; 36/36 total).
